name: Final Act
oracle_text:
Choose one or more —
• Destroy all creatures.
• Destroy all planeswalkers.
• Destroy all battles.
• Exile all graveyards.
• Each opponent loses all counters.

needs.what: an op that removes every counter of every kind from each player it names (here each opponent): poison and energy today, and any other player counter kind (experience, rad, ticket) the player model later carries
needs.why_existing_wont_do: remove_counters takes a single `counter` kind and a fixed `amount` and only acts on objects chosen by `objects`, never on players; add_poison and add_energy ignore non-positive amounts, so nothing can take counters off a player, let alone all kinds at once
